breakingChangesNotes: Requires GRA 14.5.0 or later. Cases are no longer fetched. Disable fetch on the existing Cases instance before updating to 2.1.0, then set Fetch type to Incidents or Alerts with Mapper (incoming) and Incident type before re-enabling fetch (new instances default to GRAIncident-Mapper and GRAIncident). Existing GRACase incidents remain actionable via gra-case-* commands. GRA nomenclature now uses Data Source instead of Resource.
